P1_calendar_Ea_on_k.rule: use Schimpe unless the values differ by > 20 % of the primary (Schimpe)
P1_calendar_Ea_on_k.why_double: with Naumann's virtual-time rule (Eq. 17) Q = sqrt(sum k^2 dt), so a factor on k enters the clock squared

naumann.source: Naumann 2018 p. 164 Eq. (12), Table 7; fitted at 40 C, t_end = 29 months

schimpe.source: Schimpe 2018 p. A184 Eqs. (8)-(9), Appendix Eqs. (A1)-(A2), Table AI

tum_check.rule: paper function if |naumann/TUM - 1| <= 0.30 at every TUM SOC 12.5-100 %

P2_k_SOC.clock_use: the clock weight is k_SOC(SOC)^2 (virtual-time consistency, see P1.why_double); linear k_SOC = sensitivity

f_oh_sony.note: stated 6.2 %; Table 3 areas sum 88.46 cm2 over (150.2+142.1) x 5.7 cm2 = 5.3 %; stated value used

P3_overhang.reversible_relation: Delta C = (SOC_t0 - SOC_test) * (A_anode/A_cathode - 100 %); Lewerenz 2018 p. 155 Eq. (3)/(4), Table 4 (SOC_t0 = 6 %)

t_full_days.source: Lewerenz 2018 p. 157 sec. 4.6: PH^MinHi rises after ~100 d (50 C), ~250 d (40 C), ~490 d (30 C)
t_full_days.note: the 2026-10-16 notes said 150 d at 50 C; the PDF text says 100 d

P3_overhang.tau_rule: tau_oh(T) = t_full(T)/3 from the stated-Ea line through (50 C, 100 d); fitted line = sensitivity
P3_overhang.A_oh_prior: logA_oh ~ N(ln(f_oh * (SOC_op_mean - SOC_0) * Q_nom), ln 2), f_oh = 0.062, SOC_0 = 0.30

P4_cycle.finding: partly reversible accelerated loss only in static shallow cycles (DOC < 80 %); 'a phenomenon which needs to be investigated more thoroughly' (p. 6-7); dynamic profiles at 40 C: pure cycle share 28.35 % (PV-HESS) and 2.61 % (PV-PCR-BESS) of combined loss; calendar part matches the 40 C / 50 % SOC static test
